jupas.shortDescription: an class="icon-arrow-up-black"> Sociology is the scientific study of society. Sociologists study the social lives of people and groups to understand how social factors shape one’s mind and behaviour. The Sociological Imagination helps you understand social phenomena from different perspectives. The Department of Sociology at CUHK has the longest history and the most comprehensive curriculum of its kind in Hong Kong. We currently focus on six research clusters: Crime and Deviance; Economic, Politics & Society; Family, Gender and Sexuality; Population, Health and Migration; Stratification and Education; and Computational Social Science. All of our teaching staff excel in their fields of specialization. Students are required to complete a capstone thesis project before graduation. In addition, students can choose to concentrate on one or more of the three areas of concentration: 1) Research Methods and Data Analytics, 2) Sociology and Social Policy, 3) Society, Sustainability and Technology, and Human Security and Social Governance. Sociology students are often eager to explore the world. On average, 20+ students leave for exchange in overseas universities annually. To prepare students for their future career, the Department offered 20+ internship opportunities throughout the year . The Department now offers a new four-year double-major option in collaboration with the School of Journalism and Communication and a BSSc (sociology)-Juris Doctor double-degree option in collaboration with the Faculty of Law. We provide one of the best sociological training in the region. According to The Quacquarelli Symonds World University Rankings by Subject (Sociology) 2025, our Department is ranked the 18 th in the world and 2 nd in Asia.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Unleash your Sociological Imagination through our Sociology Programme! Welcome to our prestigious sociology programme, where we invite you to embark on an intellectual journey guided by the Sociological Imagination. Our curriculum fosters the development of critical thinking skills, enabling you to think critically from diverse perspectives, discern reality amid complexities, and gain insights into the intricate workings of society. By exploring the study of social networks, organisations and institutions, you will delve into the fascinating fabric of human interactions. Drawing from a rich tradition, our programme boasts a long history and the most comprehensive curriculum in Hong Kong, with renowned professors who have spearheaded advancements in sociology. With research interests spanning a wide array of areas, our faculty will equip you with the knowledge and skills to navigate the complex social landscape, from analysing Chinese and Asian societies to exploring the themes of education, stratification and social mobility, demography, gender, family, criminology, the study of the Greater Bay Area and more. Join us to become a proficient sociologist and contribute to a better understanding of our interconnected world. THINK CRITICALLY from diverse perspectives DISCERN REALITY amid complexities GAIN INSIGHTS into the workings of society

cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: Our Sociology programme is designed to shape your career path through various avenues. Benefit from our unique credit-bearing Internship course, gain valuable experience in an overseas internship at Princeton University, and expand your horizons with exchange opportunities at the University of Warwick and the University of Kent in the UK. Explore our three unique concentrations to specialise in your area of interest. We also offer career training workshops and alumni talks to provide you with the skills and insights needed to succeed in your chosen field. Prepare for a rewarding career with our comprehensive Sociology programme. Students can declare a maximum of two concentrations in the following areas upon fulfilling the required conditions: Sociology and Social Policy Research Methods and Data Analytics Society, Sustainability and Technology Human Security and Social Governance For details, please refer to: https://www.soc.cuhk.edu.hk/undergraduate/curriculum/concentrations/ Throughout the past 60 years, our Sociology alumni have excelled in diverse career sectors, showcasing the versatility and value of their sociological training. Many alumni have found success in government positions, shaping policy and driving social change. Others have thrived in the commercial and business sectors, applying their deep understanding of social dynamics to enhance organisational effectiveness. Some have made significant contributions to NGOs, advocating for the rights and welfare of marginalized communities. Some sociology alumni have ventured into social entrepreneurship, utilising their sociological knowledge to create their own impactful social enterprises. Utilizing their sociological insights to analyse and communicate social issues, a number of alumni have thrived in media and related fields. For those pursuing further academic studies, our graduates have been admitted to prestigious postgraduate programmes worldwide, becoming accomplished researchers and scholars. The comprehensive sociological education we provide empowers our graduates to excel in a wide range of careers, making a positive impact on society. Join us and think in a sociological way! If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW

curriculum.title: Curriculum & Programme Structure
content: The Sociology programme at CUHK is the longest-established and most comprehensive in Hong Kong. It is designed to unleash your Sociological Imagination, enabling you to think critically from diverse perspectives and discern reality amid complexities.
Students are required to complete a capstone thesis project before graduation.
Areas of Concentration (choose up to two):
- Research Methods and Data Analytics
- Sociology and Social Policy
- Society, Sustainability and Technology
- Human Security and Social Governance
The Department focuses on six research clusters:
- Crime and Deviance
- Economic, Politics & Society
- Family, Gender and Sexuality
- Population, Health and Migration
- Stratification and Education
- Computational Social Science
New double-major option with the School of Journalism and Communication, and a BSSc (Sociology)-Juris Doctor double-degree option with the Faculty of Law.
All teaching staff excel in their fields of specialization.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: Our Sociology programme is designed to shape your career path through various avenues.
Unique credit-bearing Internship course, including overseas internship at Princeton University.
Exchange opportunities at the University of Warwick and the University of Kent in the UK.
Career training workshops and alumni talks.
Alumni have excelled in diverse sectors:
- Government positions (policy shaping, social change)
- Commercial and business sectors (organisational effectiveness)
- NGOs (advocacy for marginalised communities)
- Social entrepreneurship
- Media and related fields
- Further academic studies at prestigious postgraduate programmes worldwide

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: CUHK's Shatin campus offers a vibrant and supportive learning environment with nine colleges, each providing unique residential and educational experiences.
The Department of Sociology is housed within the Faculty of Social Science, with access to state-of-the-art facilities and research centres.
On average, 20+ students go on exchange to overseas universities annually.
The Department offers 20+ internship opportunities throughout the year.
Students can participate in the Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies for policy research.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission Strategy
content: With only 37 first-year places and 201 Band A applications in 2025, the programme is highly competitive.
Band A offer rate: approximately 15.9% (32 offers from 201 Band A applicants).
Band A applications per offer: ~6.3.
The median and quartile scores are all 26.5 (Best 5), indicating a very tight score band – every point matters.
Interview is required for selected applicants; preparation is key.
Applicants should aim for at least Level 4 in English and Mathematics, and Level 5 or above in Chinese and at least one elective.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Faculty Excellence
content: CUHK Sociology has produced many distinguished alumni who have made significant contributions to Hong Kong and beyond:
- Lau Siu-kai (劉兆佳): Former Head of the Central Policy Unit of the HKSAR Government; prominent sociologist and political scientist.
- Lui Tai-lok (呂大樂): Former Chair Professor of Sociology at CUHK; expert on Hong Kong social stratification and labour studies.
- Wong Siu-lun (黃紹倫): Former Director of the Centre of Asian Studies at HKU; renowned for research on Hong Kong entrepreneurs and migration.
- Chan Kwok-shing (陳國成): Professor of Sociology at CUHK; known for work on social networks and Chinese society.
- Ng Chun-hung (吳俊雄): Former Associate Professor of Sociology at CUHK; cultural critic and co-founder of the Hong Kong Cultural Studies programme.
Faculty Excellence:
- The Sociology programme is consistently ranked among the top in Asia (QS 2025: #18 in the world, #2 in Asia).
- Faculty members publish in leading international journals and receive prestigious research grants (e.g., RGC, GRF).
- The department runs the Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies, producing influential policy research.

tips.title: Ace Sir's Sociology Admission Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target Score: 26.5+ (Best 5)**
- The median and LQ are both 26.5, so you need at least 26.5 to be competitive.
- With English weighted x1.5, a strong English grade (Level 5 or above) can significantly boost your score.
**2. Prioritise English and Chinese**
- English is weighted 1.5x – aim for Level 5 or above.
- Chinese should be at least Level 5 (median admit profile shows Level 5).
**3. Excel in at least one Elective**
- The median admit profile shows a 5* in the first elective – a star grade makes a difference.
- Choose electives that align with your strengths and interest in sociology (e.g., Economics, Geography, History).
**4. Mathematics: Level 4 is the baseline**
- Median and LQ both show Level 4 in Mathematics – don't neglect this subject.
**5. Prepare for the Interview**
- Interview is required for selected applicants – practice articulating your sociological imagination.
- Be ready to discuss current social issues and why you want to study sociology at CUHK.
**6. Demonstrate Interest in Sociology**
- Read sociology-related books or articles; mention them in your interview or personal statement.
- Show awareness of CUHK's research clusters (e.g., crime, family, migration).
**7. Build a Strong Band A Strategy**
- Put JS4886 as your Band A choice to maximise offer chances (Band A offer rate ~15.9%).
- Consider having a backup programme in Band B with slightly lower requirements.
**8. Leverage Internship and Exchange Opportunities**
- Mention your interest in the Princeton internship or Warwick/Kent exchange in your application.
- This shows you have researched the programme's unique offerings.
**9. Apply Early and Check Requirements**
- Ensure you meet the general entrance requirements (Chinese Level 3, English Level 3, Math Level 2, CSD Attained).
- If you have an Applied Learning subject with 'Attained with Distinction I/II', it can be used as an extra elective.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 香港中文大學社會學課程是香港歷史最悠久、最全面的社會學課程。旨在釋放您的社會學想像力，讓您從多元視角批判思考，在複雜中辨別真相。
學生須在畢業前完成頂石論文項目。
專修範疇（最多可選兩個）：
- 研究方法與數據分析
- 社會學與社會政策
- 社會、可持續發展與科技
- 人類安全與社會治理
學系聚焦六大研究集群：
- 犯罪與偏差行為
- 經濟、政治與社會
- 家庭、性別與性
- 人口、健康與遷移
- 階層化與教育
- 計算社會科學
新增與新聞與傳播學院合辦的雙主修選項，以及社會科學學士（社會學）-法學博士雙學位選項。
所有教學人員均在其專業領域表現卓越。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 我們的社會學課程通過多種途徑為您的職業生涯鋪路。
獨特的學分制實習課程，包括普林斯頓大學海外實習。
與英國華威大學及肯特大學的交換機會。
職業培訓工作坊及校友講座。
校友在多元領域表現卓越：
- 政府職位（政策制定、社會變革）
- 商業及企業界（組織效能）
- 非政府組織（邊緣社群倡導）
- 社會企業
- 媒體及相關領域
- 全球頂尖研究生院深造

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: 香港中文大學沙田校園提供充滿活力的學習環境，設有九所書院，各具獨特的住宿及教育體驗。
社會學系隸屬社會科學院，可使用先進設施及研究中心。
每年平均有20多名學生前往海外大學交流。
學系全年提供20多個實習機會。
學生可參與香港亞太研究所的政策研究。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學策略
content: 2025年僅37個首年學額，Band A申請人數201人，競爭激烈。
Band A錄取率：約15.9%（201名Band A申請人中錄取32人）。
Band A申請人與錄取比例：約6.3:1。
中位數及四分位數均為26.5（最佳5科），分數區間非常集中，每一分都至關重要。
需要面試（選定申請人），準備面試是關鍵。
申請人應至少達到英國語文及數學第4級，中國語文及至少一門選修科第5級或以上。

alumni.title: 著名校友及學系成就
content: 中大社會學培養了眾多傑出校友，對香港及社會貢獻良多：
- 劉兆佳：前香港特區政府中央政策組首席顧問；著名社會學家及政治學家。
- 呂大樂：前中大社會學講座教授；香港社會階層化及勞工研究專家。
- 黃紹倫：前香港大學亞洲研究中心主任；以香港企業家及移民研究聞名。
- 陳國成：中大社會學教授；以社會網絡及中國社會研究著稱。
- 吳俊雄：前中大社會學副教授；文化評論家及香港文化研究課程聯合創辦人。
學系成就：
- 社會學課程在亞洲持續名列前茅（QS 2025：全球第18，亞洲第2）。
- 教職員在頂尖國際期刊發表論文，並獲得研究資助局等著名研究撥款。
- 學系營運香港亞太研究所，產出具影響力的政策研究。

tips.title: Ace Sir的社會學入學策略 — 9個實用貼士
content: - 中位數及下四分位數均為26.5，因此您需要至少26.5分才具競爭力。
- 英國語文比重x1.5，優秀的英文成績（第5級或以上）可大幅提升總分。
**2. 優先處理英國語文及中國語文**
- 英國語文比重1.5倍，目標第5級或以上。
- 中國語文至少第5級（中位數錄取者成績顯示第5級）。
**3. 在至少一門選修科表現出色**
- 中位數錄取者第一選修科為5*，星級成績至關重要。
- 選擇與您優勢及社會學興趣相關的選修科（如經濟、地理、歷史）。
**4. 數學：第4級是基本門檻**
- 中位數及下四分位數均顯示數學第4級，切勿忽視此科。
**5. 準備面試**
- 需要面試（選定申請人），練習闡述您的社會學想像力。
- 準備討論當前社會議題及為何選擇中大社會學。
**6. 展現對社會學的興趣**
- 閱讀社會學相關書籍或文章，在面試或個人陳述中提及。
- 了解中大的研究集群（如犯罪、家庭、遷移）。
**7. 制定強勁的Band A策略**
- 將JS4886放在Band A以最大化錄取機會（Band A錄取率約15.9%）。
- 考慮在Band B放置要求稍低的後備課程。
**8. 善用實習及交流機會**
- 在申請中提及您對普林斯頓實習或華威/肯特交流的興趣。
- 這顯示您已研究課程的獨特優勢。
**9. 提早申請並核對要求**
- 確保符合一般入學要求（中國語文第3級、英國語文第3級、數學第2級、公民科達標）。
- 如有「達標並表現優異I/II」的應用學習科目，可作為額外選修科。
